title: Effective Lagrangian of a fermion field in a nontrivial topology under magnetic effects
summary: We have investigated a fermionic system from the perspective of an effective quantum field theory defined on a nontrivial topology in the presence of an external magnetic field. Using the proper-time representation, we obtained one-loop expressions for the corresponding effective Lagrangian, taking into account all Landau levels in the propagator. We also computed the significant boundary-induced contributions to the system's magnetization.
